mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month signals an improving labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over the past 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) relative to the previous year signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is lower than the previous year.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% month-over-month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with supply expansion
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and FEDFUNDS < 2%.
